description: This Java class 'SqlPartitioningRepository' manages SQL table partitions, including creation, dropping, and caching of partition metadata, specifically for PostgreSQL databases within the Thingsboard project.

classes.name: SqlPartitioningRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing SQL table partitions, including creation, deletion, and cache management.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Executes the SQL query to save a partition.

methods.name: createPartitionIfNotExists
methods.description: Creates a new partition for a table if it does not already exist.

methods.name: dropPartitionsBefore
methods.description: Drops partitions older than a specified timestamp.

methods.name: cleanupPartitionsCache
methods.description: Removes expired partition entries from the cache.

methods.name: detachAndDropPartition
methods.description: Detaches and drops a specific partition table.

methods.name: getPartitionEndTime
methods.description: Calculates the end time of a partition based on start time and duration.

methods.name: fetchPartitions
methods.description: Retrieves list of partition start times for a table.

methods.name: calculatePartitionStartTime
methods.description: Calculates the start time of a partition based on a timestamp and partition duration.

methods.name: getCurrentServerVersion
methods.description: Fetches the PostgreSQL server version number, cached after first retrieval.

methods.name: getJdbcTemplate
methods.description: Returns the JdbcTemplate instance used for database operations.
